note: 0.1.3 hook speed (cmd/hook.pl _warm_gsd): Stop reads the GSD scan cache (<watch>/<sid>/gsd-scan.json) on toward the transcript's end when it is missing or 1 MiB or more behind, so the checkpoint before a compaction reads only the last bytes (a cold scan of a whole 50 MB transcript ran out of the checkpoint's 1.5 s under load: `GSD: not measured (timeout)`, and drove its p90). A Stop with no cache scans and writes it to the end; the next Stop, a few rows later, reads nothing (no work at every Stop); one 1.2 MB later reads on to the new end

steps.name: no cache: the Stop writes it
a few rows later: the cache is close enough, nothing is read
1.2 MB later: read on to the new end
